producer_report.summary: Every page from xtask/src/site.rs now has a skip link to #main and a learning-path ordered list of links to its sections. It also has a CSS-only core/expert checkbox: Glossary and Claims and sources are marked expert and hidden until it is ticked. The CSS adds :focus-visible outlines and a prefers-reduced-motion rule, and the viewport meta and dark mode are kept. The new test the_page_offers_accessibility_tracks_and_a_learning_path asserts each feature. OLY-B-D2-02 in docs/spec.toml now names this mechanism, with a measure ending `status: not shown`. CHANGELOG.md and docs/design/explainer-site.md are updated.

mistakes: First placed the nav before the header, which broke the site_page integration test; moved it after the header.
Guessed the expert section's step number in the new test, which failed; made the assertion independent of the number.
learnings: xtask/tests/site_page.rs finds the first occurrence of the text 'Start here' to locate the page header, so any earlier link text with that phrase breaks it.
Tests pin `</header><section id="job-evidence">`, so content added after the header in finish() sits after that section.
The Bash hook here allows only cargo, git, ls, chmod, mv and rm; pipes, grep and tail are denied.
